title: rosa wichurana var. poteriifolia
intro: Rosa wichurana var. poteriifolia, commonly known as the 'Cinderella' or 'Alberich' rose, is a variety of rose plant known for its unique and delicate features. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to soothe skin irritations and promote overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Rosa wichurana var. poteriifolia include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce stress and anxiety, and promote a sense of relaxation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been studied for their potential therapeutic applications.
